front: 〔真题·2010年 简答〕Classify the word-formation process in each item: xerox, interpol, flu, OPEC, Nobel, televise, better (verb), Orlon, watt, edit.
back:
依次为 coinage, blending, clipping, acronym formation, eponymy, back-formation, conversion, coinage, eponymy, back-formation。
——
📌 解析：考Chapter 4构词法（笔记Chapter4 pp.6-8）。需区分coinage（不基于既有语素的造词，多为商标词）、eponymy（源自专有名词）、acronym/abbreviation（首字母缩合，前者可拼读成词）、clipping（截短）、blending（混合）、back-formation（去真实或假想后缀逆构）、conversion（转类）。常见失分点：televise、edit 是逆构而非转类；Orlon、xerox 属商标造词；OPEC 可拼读故为 acronym。
source: 东师学科英语专业课二历年真题.pdf · 2010年真题（简答）

front: 〔真题·2010年 简答〕Paraphrase each ambiguous sentence in two ways: “They finally decided on the boat”; “Can you see the man with a pair of binoculars?”; “The design is full of big squares and circles”; “Tom hates his boss and so do I”; “Flying planes can be dangerous.”
back:
Possible readings: the decision was made aboard the boat / concerned the boat; the man has the binoculars / the observer uses them; both squares and circles are big / only the squares are big; I hate Tom's boss / I hate my own boss; planes that fly are dangerous / piloting planes is dangerous.
——
📌 解析：考Chapter 5结构歧义（笔记Chapter5 p.10）与Chapter 3重音/语调消歧（pp.14-15）。逐句给出两种 paraphrase 即可，最好点明歧义来源：介词短语挂靠（VP状语 vs NP修饰）、并列结构辖域（big 修饰范围）、"so do I"的指代对象、动名词主语 Flying planes 的两种解读。失分点：只给一种释义，或只说"有歧义"而不改写。
source: 东师学科英语专业课二历年真题.pdf · 2010年真题（简答）

front: 〔真题·2010年 简答〕Draw two phrase-structure parses for “Tom found a journal on Wall Street.”
back:
The PP on Wall Street can attach to the VP (Tom found it while there) or to the NP (a journal associated with/on Wall Street).
——
📌 解析：考Chapter 5短语结构规则与树形图（笔记Chapter5 pp.13-14）。关键：PP "on Wall Street" 既可挂靠 VP（作地点状语：在华尔街找到了它）也可挂靠 NP（作名词修饰：一份关于/来自华尔街的期刊），两棵树需画出不同挂靠层级并标明 NP/VP/PP 等范畴标签。失分点：两棵树结构雷同或漏标节点。
source: 东师学科英语专业课二历年真题.pdf · 2010年真题（简答）

front: 〔真题·2010年 简答〕For each set, identify the least typical category member: (a) apple, pear, grape, pomegranate, banana; (b) pot, oven, knife, ladle, napkin; (c) salmon, trout, carp, whale, sardine; (d) saucer, toothpick, bowl, spoon, plate; (e) sledge, truck, ship, plane, car; (f) gun, knife, sword, tank, hand grenade, pistol; (g) emu, parrot, sparrow, peacock, swallow, dove; (h) stool, chair, couch, bed, fan, sofa; (i) thumbpin, pen, pencil, staple, ruler, rubber; (j) carrot, cabbage, spinach, cucumber, sweet corn, tomato.
back:
依次为 pomegranate, napkin, whale, toothpick, sledge, knife, emu, fan, thumbpin, sweet corn。
——
📌 解析：考Chapter 6原型范畴理论（笔记Chapter6 pp.9-10）：范畴成员地位不平等，与原型共享特征越少越边缘。判断标准是"与该组其他成员共享特征最少"：pomegranate（非日常水果）、napkin（非炊具/厨具）、whale（哺乳动物非鱼）、toothpick（非餐具）、sledge（非日常交通工具）、knife（非火器/军事武器）、emu（不会飞的鸟）、fan（非家具）、thumbpin（非书写工具）、sweet corn（可作粮食的"蔬菜"）。失分点：凭个人感觉而非特征共享度作答。
source: 东师学科英语专业课二历年真题.pdf · 2010年真题（简答）

front: 〔真题·2011年 简答〕Complete ten prompts: (1) a word's stable central meaning is its ___ meaning; (2) giving excess information flouts Grice's ___ maxim; (3) opposite terms where one entails the other's negation are ___; (4) the speech-production branch is ___ phonetics; (5) discourse organization is the ___ function; (6) meaning-distinguishing sound properties are ___ features; (7) sounds sharing features form a ___; (8) atomic-feature analysis of meaning is ___; (9) a stand-alone morpheme is ___; (10) L1 influence in “because … so” is ___.
back:
(1) referential; (2) quantity; (3) complementary antonyms; (4) articulatory; (5) textual metafunction; (6) distinctive; (7) natural class; (8) componential analysis; (9) free morpheme; (10) interference。
——
📌 解析：跨章术语填空：指称意义（Ch6 p.3）、数量准则（Ch7 p.24，信息过量即违反量的第二条）、互补反义词（Ch6 pp.5-6）、发音语音学（Ch2 p.2）、语篇（textual）元功能（Ch1 p.7）、区别性特征（Ch3 p.11）、自然类（Ch2 p.7）、成分分析法（Ch6 p.8）、自由词素（Ch4 p.4）、负迁移/干扰（Ch11 p.29）。失分点：把"提供过量信息"误答 quality；(3) 误答 gradable antonyms。
source: 东师学科英语专业课二历年真题.pdf · 2011年真题（简答）

front: 〔真题·2011年 简答〕Define immediate constituent analysis and coarticulation. Use “green grapes and pears” to show two possible constituent groupings; name anticipatory and carryover coarticulation.
back:
直接成分分析反复划分短语成分，以显示层级及歧义；“green grapes and pears”可括为 [green grapes] and [pears] 或 green [grapes and pears]。协同发音是相邻语音相互影响；预期型先于受影响音，延续型则影响后续音。
——
📌 解析：考Chapter 5直接成分分析（笔记Chapter5 p.12：自上而下逐层切分，能揭示句子的线性与层级、解释结构歧义）与Chapter 2语音学的协同发音（与Ch3 p.11同化规则方向相通）。要点：anticipatory（先行为）影响后出现的音，carryover/perseverative 影响其后的音，对应逆同化/顺同化的方向。失分点：只下定义不做两种切分；两类协同发音方向写反。
source: 东师学科英语专业课二历年真题.pdf · 2011年真题（简答）

front: 〔真题·2011年 简答〕Classify the word-formation processes illustrated by head used as a verb (headed), length → lengthen, influenza → flu, United Nations → UN, and editor → edit.
back:
(1) head used as a verb (headed): conversion; (2) length -> lengthen: derivation (the derivational suffix -en is added); (3) influenza -> flu: clipping; (4) United Nations -> UN: abbreviation (the initial letters of the phrase are put together; UN is read letter by letter); (5) editor -> edit: back-formation (a supposed suffix -or is dropped and a new verb is created).
——
📌 解析：考Chapter 4构词法（笔记Chapter4 pp.6-7）。head 作动词是 conversion；-en 加于形容词构成动词是 derivation（构成了新词位，不是屈折）；flu 截短自 influenza；UN 为首字母缩写；edit 由 editor 去 -or 为 back-formation。失分点：把 lengthen 答成 inflection；abbreviation 与 acronym（能否拼读为词）混同。
source: 东师学科英语专业课二历年真题.pdf · 2011年真题（简答）

front: 〔真题·2011年 简答〕Classify the synonym differences: torch/flashlight; gentleman/guy; salt/sodium chloride; die/kick the bucket; able/be capable.
back:
Dialect; style/formality; register/domain; style/formality; collocation, respectively.
——
📌 解析：考Chapter 6同义词的五类差异（笔记Chapter6 p.5）：方言（torch/flashlight 英美不同）、语体正式度（gentleman/guy；die/kick the bucket）、语域/使用领域（salt/sodium chloride 餐桌vs实验室）、感情色彩、搭配（able to / capable of）。失分点：register（按使用领域）与 style/formality（按正式程度）混淆；漏答 collocation。
source: 东师学科英语专业课二历年真题.pdf · 2011年真题（简答）

front: 〔真题·2011年 简答〕In “I think you may find it here tomorrow,” identify and classify the deictic expressions.
back:
I, you and it are person deixis; here is place deixis; tomorrow is time deixis.
——
📌 解析：考Chapter 7指示语分类（笔记Chapter7 pp.18-19）：人称、地点、时间、篇章、社会五类。句中 I、you、it 为人称指示，here 为地点指示，tomorrow 为时间指示。失分点：漏掉 it（它也是人称指示）；把 tomorrow 误判为篇章指示；不点明指示语须依赖语境确定所指。
source: 东师学科英语专业课二历年真题.pdf · 2011年真题（简答）

front: 〔真题·2011年 简答〕Give two readings for each sentence: “Mr. Smith finally made the decision on the boat”; “They said Susan would go yesterday.”
back:
on the boat 可指决定发生在船上或决定内容关于船；yesterday 可修饰 said（他们昨天说 Susan 将去）或 go（他们说 Susan 昨天去）。
——
📌 解析：考Chapter 5结构歧义（笔记Chapter5 p.10）：介词短语与时间状语的辖域歧义。on the boat 可为地点状语（决定是在船上做出的）或与决定内容相关（决定是关于船的）；yesterday 可修饰主句动词 said（昨天说的）或从句动词 go（昨天去）。失分点：只给一种读法，或读法之间无结构差异。
source: 东师学科英语专业课二历年真题.pdf · 2011年真题（简答）

front: 〔真题·2011年 论述〕Comment on “If Aristotle were Chinese, his logic would be different” using the Sapir–Whorf hypothesis.
back:
This statement invites us to consider how language, culture and thought interact, which is precisely the concern of the Sapir-Whorf hypothesis. The hypothesis holds that the language we speak influences, and possibly determines, the way we perceive and conceptualize the world. It is interpreted in two versions. The determinism (strong) version claims that language determines our thinking, so that different languages may lead to unique ways of understanding the world; the relativism (weak) version holds that the similarity between languages is only relative: the greater their structural differentiation, the more diverse will be the conceptualization of the world, for culture affects the way we think through language, especially in our classification of the experienced world.

If Aristotle had been Chinese, the strong version would predict that he would have inherited a different conceptual apparatus encoded in Chinese and hence a different logic; Aristotle's logic would then be a product of the Greek language rather than of universal reason. The weak version offers a more defensible reading: Chinese categories, metaphors and culturally loaded expressions might have led a Chinese Aristotle to different habitual conceptualizations, for example more holistic and context-based styles of argument than the formal-analytic logic of Greek philosophy, yet it does not follow that he could not think in the Greek manner.

Most evidence supports only the weak version. Speakers of different languages can translate, borrow concepts and understand one another, which the strong version cannot explain. A balanced comment is therefore that language is a guide to, not a prison of, thought: if Aristotle were Chinese, his logic would very likely have been expressed differently and its habitual emphases might have differed, but the human logical capacity itself is not determined by the particular language one speaks. Language, culture and thought mutually influence one another rather than standing in one-way determination.
——
📌 解析：考Chapter 10 Sapir-Whorf假说（笔记Chapter10 p.21）。答题套路：先述假说及两个版本（决定论/强式：语言决定思维；相对论/弱式：语言影响习惯性思维，结构差异越大概念化差异越大），再用其评论该命题：亚里士多德的逻辑或受希腊语影响，若为汉人其习惯性概念化可能不同，但语言并不完全决定思维（跨语言可译、可相互理解反驳强式）。失分点：只背定义不结合评论；一边倒支持强式。
source: 东师学科英语专业课二历年真题.pdf · 2011年真题（论述）

front: 〔真题·2012年 简答〕Judge these nine statements T/F: (1) words are the smallest meaningful sound-and-meaning units; (2) an intradisciplinary account covers sound, form and reference; (3) manner of articulation concerns whether airflow is blocked or obstructed; (4) phonetics studies sound systems while phonology studies production; (5) Chomsky gives innate ability a central role and experience a lesser one; (6) representational meaning is based on reference; (7) tense is deictic; (8) unlimited novel sentences illustrate arbitrariness; (9) "boy" alone is an immediate constituent of "The boy kicked the ball."
back:
依次为 F, F, T, F, T, F, T, F, F。要点：词不是最小有意义单位（应为语素）；语言分析第三项为意义而非指称；第4项颠倒了语音学与音系学；表征意义看 sense；新句体现创造性；直接成分是 the boy。
——
📌 解析：九道判断跨Ch1/2/3/5/6/7：(1) 最小音义结合单位是语素非词（Ch4 p.2）；(2) 语言系统三方面为 sound/structure/meaning（Ch1 p.10）非 reference；(3) 发音方式确指气流完全受阻或部分阻碍（Ch2 p.4）；(4) 语音学研究发音、音系学研究声音系统，题干颠倒（Ch3 p.9）；(5) Chomsky 强调先天语言能力（Ch5 p.12）；(6) 表征意义基于 sense 非 reference（Ch6 p.3）；(7) 时态是指示性的（时间指示）；(8) 无限新句体现创造性非任意性（Ch1 pp.3-4）；(9) 第一层直接成分是 The boy / kicked the ball（Ch5 p.12）。
source: 东师学科英语专业课二历年真题.pdf · 2012年真题（简答）

front: 〔真题·2012年 名词解释〕Define overgeneralization and gradable antonyms; give one example of each.
back:
过度概括是把目标语规则用到不适用情形，如 *He can sings。等级反义词位于连续尺度两端，肯定一方不必然推出另一方的否定，如 not rich 不一定等于 poor。
——
📌 解析：考Chapter 11过度概括（笔记Chapter11 p.25、p.29：语内错误来源之一，把目的语规则用到不适用情形）与Chapter 6等级反义词（p.5：两极之间有连续统，肯定一方不蕴涵否定另一方，可用程度副词修饰、有比较级）。失分点：过度概括例句写成拼写错误而非语法规则误用；把等级反义词与互补反义词（肯定一方即蕴涵否定另一方）混淆。
source: 东师学科英语专业课二历年真题.pdf · 2012年真题（名词解释）

front: 〔真题·2012年 简答〕In “None of my brother's friends care for the impractical suggestion,” identify each bound morpheme, its function and whether it is inflectional or derivational.
back:
's and plural -s are inflectional; im-, -al and -tion are derivational. Inflection marks grammatical features; derivation forms a new lexeme or changes meaning/category.
——
📌 解析：考Chapter 4屈折词素与派生词素之辨（笔记Chapter4 pp.4-5）。's（属格）与 -s（复数）为屈折，只表语法范畴、不造新词；im-、-al、-tion 为派生，可改变词类/意义、构成新词位。失分点：把 's 当作派生；说不出关键区别——派生创造词位（lexeme），屈折只构成词位的形式（forms of lexemes）。
source: 东师学科英语专业课二历年真题.pdf · 2012年真题（简答）

front: 〔真题·2012年 简答〕Draw two parses for “I can see an old man with a telescope.”
back:
The PP with a telescope can modify the VP (I use it to see) or the NP (the old man has one).
——
📌 解析：考Chapter 5树形图与介词短语挂靠歧义（笔记Chapter5 pp.13-14），与2010年 "Tom found a journal on Wall Street" 同型。with a telescope 可挂 VP（工具状语：我用望远镜看）或挂 NP（后置定语：老人带着望远镜）。失分点：树图不标范畴标签；只给文字解释不画树。
source: 东师学科英语专业课二历年真题.pdf · 2012年真题（简答）

front: 〔真题·2012年 简答〕Revise VP → (Aux) V PP so it can generate “Her dog always sleeps under it” and “These pigs can sometimes stay in the house.”
back:
Add an optional adverb slot between Aux and V: VP -> (Aux) (Adv) V PP. Then "Her dog always sleeps under it" is generated by choosing Aux = (present tense), Adv = always, V = sleeps, PP = under it; and "These pigs can sometimes stay in the house" by choosing Aux = can, Adv = sometimes, V = stay, PP = in the house. Because the adverb is bracketed as optional, the revised rule still generates all the original (Aux) V PP strings, so nothing that the old rule generated is lost.
——
📌 解析：考Chapter 5短语结构规则（笔记Chapter5 p.13）：括号内成分为可选成分。句子中 always/sometimes 出现在 Aux 与 V 之间，故增加可选副词槽得 VP -> (Aux) (Adv) V PP。失分点：把 Adv 写成必选成分导致旧句子无法生成；忘记说明括号成分的可选性保证规则向后兼容。
source: 东师学科英语专业课二历年真题.pdf · 2012年真题（简答）

front: 〔真题·2012年 论述〕Distinguish register from regional and social dialects. Explain how a teacher's view of language can shape foreign-language teaching.
back:
语域按使用情境区分（variety according to use）；地域/社会方言按使用者区分。语域可从 field、mode、tenor 描述。语言观会影响课程、材料和目标：形式取向突出结构，功能取向兼顾交际功能，交际取向重视交际能力。

展开（英文作答参考）：Register is a "variety according to use", while regional dialects and sociolects are "varieties according to user". One's dialect shows who you are and where you are from, while the register shows what you are doing and with whom. Register is analyzed on three dimensions: field (the purpose or subject matter - why and about what we communicate), mode (the means - how we communicate, e.g. face-to-face talk vs a letter) and tenor (the relationship between participants - with whom, e.g. close friends vs the boss). A speaker keeps one dialect but shifts registers constantly, e.g. salt at the dinner table vs sodium chloride in the laboratory.

As for the second question, as S. Pit Corder says, the way we teach language is influenced, even determined, by what we believe language to be. At the preparatory level, specialists' views of language guide syllabus design and material development; at the classroom level, a teacher's understanding of the nature of language influences what and how he teaches. A formal/structural view of language highlights sentence patterns and grammatical accuracy; a functional view (e.g. Halliday) specifies content not only in grammatical elements but also in the functional items students need to communicate successfully; a communicative view takes the development of learners' communicative competence - grammatical, sociolinguistic, discourse and strategic - as the objective, favoring meaningful, interactive activities. The teacher's view of language thus shapes the curriculum, the materials, the methodology and even the tests.
——
📌 解析：考Chapter 9语域与方言（笔记Chapter9 pp.11-12：variety according to use vs according to user；语域三维 field/mode/tenor）及Chapter 12语言观与教学的关系（p.33，Corder引文：教什么怎么教受语言观影响）。essay 类需分点展开并举例。失分点：语域与方言只答概念不举 example；第二问不落到大纲、教材、课堂方法等具体层面。
source: 东师学科英语专业课二历年真题.pdf · 2012年真题（论述）

front: 〔真题·2013年 简答〕Complete these nine term prompts: (1) an opposition where the positive of one term entails the negative of the other; (2) phonetics of speech perception; (3) Halliday metafunction that organizes discourse; (4) L1-driven use of "because ... so" in English; (5) study of contemporary language; (6) transfer of properties from the source domain of a metaphor to its target; (7) a preceding sound making a following sound similar; (8) a face-saving lead-in before a likely dispreferred reply; (9) sentences used to perform an act.
back:
依次为 complementary antonymy, auditory phonetics, textual metafunction, interference, synchronic study, mapping, progressive assimilation, pre-sequence, performative sentence。
——
📌 解析：跨章术语填空：互补反义（Ch6 pp.5-6）、听觉语音学（Ch2 p.2）、语篇元功能（Ch1 p.7）、母语干扰（Ch11 p.29）、共时研究（Ch1 p.11）、映射 mapping（Ch6 p.13）、顺同化 progressive assimilation（Ch3 pp.11-12：前音影响后音）、前序列 pre-sequence（Ch7 pp.29-30）、施为句 performative（Ch7 p.21）。失分点：(7) 顺/逆同化方向颠倒（逆同化是后音影响前音，如鼻化规则）；(8) pre-sequence 答成 adjacency pair。
source: 东师学科英语专业课二历年真题.pdf · 2013年真题（简答）

front: 〔真题·2013年 名词解释〕Define and exemplify inflection, interlanguage and cataphoric reference.
back:
Inflection changes grammatical form without making a new lexeme; interlanguage is the evolving learner system between L1 and target language; cataphora points forward, as “When I saw her, Mary looked ill.”
——
📌 解析：考Chapter 4屈折（笔记Chapter4 p.5：只表语法范畴、不造新词位）、Chapter 11中介语（p.29：介于L1与L2之间的近似语言系统、连续体）与Chapter 7后指 cataphora（p.20：所指在后，与 anaphora 方向相反，例句如 When I saw her, Mary looked ill）。失分点：cataphora 例句把先行词放前（写成 anaphora）；interlanguage 只答"学习者语言"不点"介于L1与L2的动态系统"。
source: 东师学科英语专业课二历年真题.pdf · 2013年真题（名词解释）

front: 〔真题·2013年 简答〕A market notice reads “凉皮搬到书的对面.” Explain what “凉皮” and “书” refer to in context.
back:
广义上分别指凉皮这种食物和书；告示中则转指售卖凉皮的店和书店，表示凉皮店搬到了书店对面。
——
📌 解析：考Chapter 6概念转喻（笔记Chapter6 p.15：同一域内以一实体代另一相关实体，如整体与部分、处所与机构）。"凉皮""书"在字面层分别指食物与书籍，在告示语境中转指凉皮店与书店（REPRESENTING/INSTITUTION via 相关实体）。失分点：只答字面指称而未指出语境触发的转喻机制。
source: 东师学科英语专业课二历年真题.pdf · 2013年真题（简答）

front: 〔真题·2013年 简答〕At lunch, after students share food, a student says “我强烈要求老师吃我豆腐,” and classmates laugh. Explain the joke semantically.
back:
“豆腐”有食物的指称义，也有轻微性骚扰的联想义；该语境触发双关和笑声。
——
📌 解析：考Chapter 6联想意义中的反映意义（笔记Chapter6 p.4：通过同一表达式的另一意义产生的联想）与Ch6 p.6双关/谐音的语用价值。"吃豆腐"字面指称食物义，同时激活"占便宜/轻薄"的联想义，语境使学生的话产生双关而引发笑声。失分点：只答"一语双关"而不点明是哪种意义类型触发联想。

front: 〔真题·2013年 简答〕Compare thematic meaning: “Professor Yang wrote An Introduction to Linguistics” / “An Introduction to Linguistics was written by Professor Yang.”
back:
命题事件相同但起点不同：主动句以 Professor Yang 为 Theme，被动句以书名为 Theme；它们分别适合作为“杨教授做了什么”与“这本书发生了什么”的回答。
——
📌 解析：考Chapter 5主位结构（笔记Chapter5 pp.20-22：theme 为信息起点，其余为 rheme）。两句命题义相同（同义句关系，Ch6 p.11 synonymy），但主位不同：主动句以 Professor Yang 为起点，回答"杨教授做了什么"；被动句以书名为起点，回答"这本书怎么了/发生了什么"。失分点：只说意义相同，不谈主位与信息结构（已知信息）差异。

front: 〔真题·2013年 名词解释〕Explain: symbol, morality play, theme, negative capability, revenge tragedy, Imagism, slave narrative and Chicano literature.
back:
(1) Symbol: a person, object, image or action that signifies more than its literal meaning and conveys a further abstract idea or emotion; unlike a passing metaphor it is sustained through the work (e.g. the green light in The Great Gatsby, the scarlet A in The Scarlet Letter). (2) Morality play: a medieval dramatic genre in which abstract virtues, vices and forces are personified to dramatize the moral conflict for the human soul; the best-known example is Everyman. (3) Theme: the central or controlling idea a work explores; it is implied through plot, character and imagery rather than directly stated, and must be distinguished from the mere subject. (4) Negative capability: Keats's term for the poet's capacity to accept uncertainties, mysteries and doubts 'without any irritable reaching after fact and reason' — an ideal of open-mindedness, of 'letting the mind be a thoroughfare for all thoughts' (高分笔记2, p31). (5) Revenge tragedy: an Elizabethan-Jacobean dramatic genre in which the plot is driven by the hero's quest to avenge a murder or grave wrong, typically involving feigned madness, a play-within-the-play and the avenger's own death; Kyd initiated the type and Shakespeare's Hamlet is its supreme example. (6) Imagism: an early-20th-century poetic movement led by Ezra Pound, characterized by the use of precise imagery, clear and economical language and free rhythm; Pound's 'In a Station of the Metro' is the classic example (高分笔记5, p32-33). (7) Slave narrative: autobiographical accounts written by formerly enslaved people (e.g. Frederick Douglass) recounting the horrors of bondage, the quest for literacy and escape, and indicting the institution of slavery; a formative genre of African-American literature. (8) Chicano literature: the literature of Mexican-Americans, exploring bicultural and bilingual experience, ethnic identity, discrimination and the struggle for social justice in the United States.
——
📌 解析：八个术语横跨戏剧（morality play、revenge tragedy）、诗学（symbol、theme、negative capability、Imagism）与美国族裔文学（slave narrative、Chicano literature），须逐条编号作答，每个术语按'定义+特征+代表作家作品'三步写。关键归属：negative capability 必须归于济慈（笔记2 p31），Imagism 必须归于庞德（笔记5 p32）。常见失分点：把 morality play 与 miracle play 混淆、把 slave narrative 写成一般奴隶制历史叙述而漏掉'自传体'这一文体特征。
source: 东师学科英语专业课二历年真题.pdf · 2013年真题（名词解释）

front: 〔真题·2014年 简答〕Name the word-formation process and give your own example for: refrigerator → fridge; Watt (name) → watt; United Nations → U.N.; former shampoo brand → generic shampoo; motor + hotel → motel.
back:
(1) refrigerator -> fridge: clipping (a polysyllabic word is shortened by deleting syllables); (2) Watt -> watt: eponymy (the word originates from a proper name); (3) United Nations -> U.N.: abbreviation (initial letters are used and read letter by letter, not as a word); (4) a former shampoo brand name used for shampoo in general: coinage - an invented trade name has become an ordinary common noun (genericization); (5) motor + hotel -> motel: blending (parts of two free words are fused into one).
——
📌 解析：考Chapter 4构词法（笔记Chapter4 pp.6-8）：fridge 截短、watt 专有名词来源（eponymy）、U.N. 首字母缩写（不可拼读故为 abbreviation 非 acronym）、品牌名转普名答 coinage/类化、motel 混合。第二问要求自举例词，需与所答构词法类型匹配。失分点：fridge 误答 back-formation；U.N. 误答 acronym。
source: 东师学科英语专业课二历年真题.pdf · 2014年真题（简答）

front: 〔真题·2014年 名词解释〕Define phonology, allophones, suprasegmental features and TG grammar. Distinguish morpheme/allomorph and theme/rheme.
back:
Phonology studies language-specific sound systems; allophones are context-dependent realizations of one phoneme; suprasegmentals include stress, intonation and tone; TG grammar models grammatical sentences using finite phrase-structure and transformational rules. A morpheme is a minimal meaningful unit; allomorphs are variants of one morpheme. Theme is the message's starting point; rheme is the remainder.
——
📌 解析：五个定义跨Ch3/4/5：音系学研究特定语言的声音系统与规律（笔记Chapter3 p.9）；音位变体 allophone 是音位在特定语境中的实现（pp.9-10，互补分布）；超音段特征包括重音、语调、声调（p.13）；TG语法用有限规则生成且只生成合语法句、含深层/表层结构与转换规则（Chapter5 pp.12-13）；词素为最小有意义的单位、词素变体为同一词素的变体（Chapter4 pp.2-3）；主位为信息起点、述位为其余部分（Chapter5 p.20）。失分点：allomorph 与 allophone、morpheme 的对应关系张冠李戴；漏 theme 未必等于语法主语。
source: 东师学科英语专业课二历年真题.pdf · 2014年真题（名词解释）

front: 〔真题·2014年 简答〕Using the data car [kʰaː], scar [sk=aː], “this car” [ðɪs kʰaː], discard [dɪsk=aːd], explain raised h and = and state the aspiration rule.
back:
In these narrow transcriptions the raised h (as in [k_h]) is the diacritic marking aspiration, and the raised equals sign (as in [k=]) marks an unaspirated sound. The data show that /k/ is aspirated ([k_h]) word-initially in car and in "this car" where k begins a stressed syllable, but unaspirated ([k=]) in the /s/-clusters of scar and discard. The aspiration rule therefore states: voiceless stops (/p, t, k/) are aspirated when they occur initially in a stressed syllable (pin, team, cool, car), but they are unaspirated when they follow /s/ in the same syllable (spin, scar, discard). Aspiration is thus a non-distinctive, predictable feature in English, and [k_h] and [k=] are allophones of the single phoneme /k/ in complementary distribution.
——
📌 解析：考Chapter 3窄式转写附加符号（笔记Chapter2-3：diacritic 定义见 Ch2 p.3）与送气规则（Ch3 p.12）。上标 h 标送气、上标 = 标不送气；规则：清塞音出现于重读音节首时送气（car），/s/ 后不送气（scar, discard）；[kʰ]与[k=]为 /k/ 的互补分布音位变体。失分点：只写规则不指出两变体的音位学地位（非区别性、可预测）。
source: 东师学科英语专业课二历年真题.pdf · 2014年真题（简答）

front: 〔真题·2014年 简答〕List the allomorphs and distribution of English negative prefix in-; give two examples for each form.
back:
im- before bilabials (impossible, immoral); ir- before /r/ (irregular, irresistible); il- before /l/ (illegal, illogical); in- elsewhere.
——
📌 解析：考Chapter 4词素变体 allomorph（笔记Chapter4 p.3）：否定前缀 in- 因后续语音环境呈 im-（双唇音前）、ir-（/r/前）、il-（/l/前）、in-（其他），例：impossible/immoral、irregular/irresistible、illegal/illogical、informal/intangible。此为形态音系学（屈折/派生形态受语音条件制约）的典型例证。失分点：例词不符合语音条件；漏掉"in- elsewhere"这一默认形式。

front: 〔真题·2014年 简答〕Describe active-to-passive transformation. Compare “John turned off the machine” and “The machine was turned off by John” in event meaning and Theme; draw a parse for the passive clause.
back:
Reorder object NP to subject; use be plus past participle agreeing in tense/number; place by before the agent. Event meaning is equivalent but Theme shifts from John to the machine. Parse should show the machine as subject and by-phrase in the predicate.
——
📌 解析：考Chapter 5被动语态转换规则（笔记Chapter5 p.15：三步——交换两个NP位置、动词替换为 be+过去分词且 be 与主语一致并保持时态、在施事NP前插入 by）与主位结构（pp.20-22）。两句事件义等值（同义句），但主位由 John 移至 the machine，信息起点不同。画树图需显示被动句主语为 the machine、谓语含 be+V-en+by短语。失分点：漏 be 的时态/数一致；误说被动句改变了事件意义。

front: 〔真题·2014年 名词解释〕Briefly define coherence, regional dialect, acculturation, learning strategy and syllabus.
back:
Coherence is conceptual connectedness of a text; regional dialect is a geographic variety; acculturation is adjustment to a new culture; learning strategies are techniques used to learn/solve problems; syllabus specifies teaching content/principles.
——
📌 解析：五个定义跨Ch8/9/11/12：连贯为语篇概念与关系层面的相互可及（笔记Chapter8 pp.2-3，注意与 cohesion 的手段/目的之别）；地域方言为按地理区域划分的变体（Ch9 p.11）；文化适应 acculturation 为对新文化的调适（Ch10 p.19、Ch11 p.31 Schumann 模式）；学习策略为学习者解决具体问题所用的方法技巧（元认知/认知/社会情感三类，Ch11 p.28）；大纲为权威规定教学内容与原则的文件（Ch12 p.34）。失分点：coherence 与 cohesion 混淆；syllabus 与 curriculum 混淆。

front: 〔真题·2014年 简答〕Explain why fast and quick are not interchangeable in every context. Comment on “That which we call a rose by any other name would smell as sweet.”
back:
Fast/quick differ in collocation: fast often emphasizes speed (fast runner), quick a short duration (quick chat). The rose statement illustrates arbitrariness: a name is not naturally determined by its referent.
——
📌 解析：前半考Chapter 6搭配意义 collocative meaning（笔记Chapter6 pp.4-5：近义词因惯常搭配对象不同而意义有别，如 able to/capable of），fast 偏速度与持续（fast runner, fast food），quick 偏历时短、反应快（quick glance, quick meal）。后半考Chapter 1任意性（pp.4-5）：名称与事物之间无自然必然联系，符号靠约定俗成，故"玫瑰换个名字照样香"。失分点：把 fast/quick 之差答成感情色彩；名言只谈修辞不点 arbitrariness。
source: 东师学科英语专业课二历年真题.pdf · 2014年真题（简答）

front: 〔真题·2015年 名词解释〕Define ethnography of communication, communicative competence, syllabus and meaning; distinguish syntagmatic from paradigmatic relations.
back:
Ethnography studies communicative events in social context (Hymes's SPEAKING factors). Communicative competence joins language knowledge with appropriate use. A syllabus specifies course content and principles. Meaning includes referential and associative aspects. Syntagmatic items co-occur in structures; paradigmatic items can occupy the same slot.
——
📌 解析：五个定义跨Ch10/9/12/6/5：交际民族志（Hymes 的 SPEAKING 框架：Setting/Scene、Participants、Ends、Act sequence、Key、Instrumentalities、Norms、Genre，笔记Chapter10 pp.21-22）；交际能力（Ch9 p.15：默会知识+使用能力，四参数）；大纲（Ch12 p.34）；意义含指称义与联想义（Ch6 pp.3-4）；横组合（chain，结构中共现）与纵聚合（choice，同槽位可替换）（Ch6 p.4/Ch5 p.16）。失分点：SPEAKING 八要素记不全；syntagmatic/paradigmatic 方向颠倒。
source: 东师学科英语专业课二历年真题.pdf · 2015年真题（名词解释）

front: 〔真题·2015年 简答〕(1) Compare “Mike broke the teapot” with “The teapot was broken by Mike” in information structure. (2) Name/explain grammatical cohesion with examples. (3) For “A: Have you seen Peter today? B: Well, if I didn't deny seeing him I wouldn't be telling a lie,” identify the flouted maxim and infer B's meaning.
back:
(1) The two clauses describe the same event, but their information structure differs. The constituent that stands for the starting point of the message is the theme; all the rest is the rheme. In "Mike broke the teapot" the theme is Mike, the person known to both speaker and hearer, and the clause answers "What did Mike do?"; in "The teapot was broken by Mike" the theme is the teapot, and the clause answers "What happened to the teapot?".
(2) Grammatical cohesion is achieved in three ways. Reference: items refer to something else for their interpretation, looking backward (anaphoric) or forward (cataphoric); personal reference by pronouns ("John is my brother. He came here yesterday."), demonstrative reference (this/that) and comparative reference (as...as). Substitution: one linguistic item replaces another - nominal substitutes (one, ones, some, same), verbal substitutes (do, does) and clausal substitutes (so, not). Ellipsis, "something left unsaid": nominal ("Would you like to hear another verse? I know three more."), verbal ("John brought some apples and Amy some pears.") and clausal ellipsis ("How many hours did you do lessons? Ten hours.").
(3) B's reply is deliberately obscure and roundabout instead of the simple "Yes, I have". This flouts the maxim of manner (avoid obscurity of expression). Assuming cooperation, A infers a conversational implicature: if B answers in such a twisted way, it must be because the direct answer would cost face or invite trouble; the implication is that B has in fact seen Peter today.
——
📌 解析：三小问跨Ch5/8/7：(1) 主位结构（笔记Chapter5 pp.20-22）；(2) 语法衔接三手段 reference/substitution/ellipsis，各配分类与例句（Chapter8 pp.3-4）；(3) 合作原则与会话含义（Ch7 pp.24-25）：B 以迂回隐晦的双重否定作答，违反方式准则（避免晦涩），由此推出"B 今天见过 Peter"。失分点：(2) 只答 reference 漏另两类；(3) 误判数量准则——关键在表达晦涩而非信息量。
source: 东师学科英语专业课二历年真题.pdf · 2015年真题（简答）

front: 〔真题·2015年 简答〕(1) In the transcriptions, pear and “this pear” show [pʰ], while spare and despair show [p⁼]; explain these diacritics and infer the aspiration rule. (2) Compare “a redcoat”/“a red coat” and “a bluebird”/“a blue bird.” (3) Describe particle movement using “John turned off the machine” and “John turned the machine off”; say whether event meaning changes. (4) Explain: Diner: “Waiter, what's this fly doing in my soup?” Waiter: “Madam, I believe that's the backstroke.”
back:
(1) The raised h is the diacritic for aspiration: [p_h] in pear and "this pear" is aspirated, while [p=] in spare and despair is unaspirated. The aspiration rule: voiceless stops are aspirated when they occur initially in a stressed syllable, but unaspirated after /s/ in the same syllable (spin, spare, despair); [p_h] and [p=] are allophones of /p/ in complementary distribution.
(2) In "a redcoat" and "a bluebird" an indefinite article is followed by a compound noun: primary stress falls on the first element and the meaning is lexicalized (a redcoat = a British soldier; a bluebird = a kind of bird). In "a red coat" and "a blue bird" the article is followed by a modifier plus a noun: stress falls on the noun and the meaning is literal (a coat that is red; a bird that is blue). Compounds show that the meaning of a compound is not always the sum of its parts.
(3) "Turn" and "off" form one discontinuous constituent of the verb phrase, and "off" is a verbal particle. By the particle movement transformation, when a verbal particle is followed by a noun phrase, the particle can be reordered to the right of the noun phrase: John turned off the machine -> John turned the machine off. The operation involves reordering only; the core event meaning is unchanged (with a pronoun object only John turned it off is possible).
(4) The diner's question is not really a request for information but an indirect complaint, meaning roughly "Why is there a fly in my soup?". The waiter deliberately takes the literal reading and answers it as if the fly were really performing an action ("doing the backstroke"), giving an irrelevant/literal response instead of an apology. This flouts the maxim of quantity (and relevance), and the flout generates the implicature that produces the joke.
——
📌 解析：四小问综合跨Ch3/4/5/7：(1) 附加符号与送气规则（笔记Chapter2 p.3、Ch3 p.12）；(2) 复合词"左重音、右词性"、词义可能词汇化非成分之和（Ch4 p.6，redcoat=英国士兵）；(3) 小品词位移转换、核心事件义不变（Ch5 p.15）；(4) 间接言语行为+违反量/关系准则产生会话含义（Ch7 pp.23-25）：侍者按字面理解间接抱怨制造幽默。失分点：复合词重音位置记反；笑话只答"幽默"不分析机制。
source: 东师学科英语专业课二历年真题.pdf · 2015年真题（简答）

front: 〔真题·2015年 论述〕Define the Critical Period Hypothesis and comment on evidence/limitations concerning age and second-language learning.
back:
The Critical Period Hypothesis (CPH) claims that there is a period, with the optimal age within roughly the first ten years of life, when language acquisition takes place naturally and effectively. In second language research it rests on two assumptions: (1) the neurological basis of language in children is different from that in adults; (2) children outperform adults in all aspects of second language acquisition.

Evidence and limitations. The truth value of the first assumption remains an open issue, because the exact neurological difference and its consequences for learning are hard to verify. The second assumption has been challenged by later studies: adults often learn certain aspects of language (morphology, syntax, vocabulary) faster at the initial stage, and late learners can still reach very high proficiency. What later research does support is a child advantage in pronunciation: early starters are far more likely to acquire native-like accent. At the same time adults are advantageous in cognitive capabilities, such as analytic ability, metalinguistic awareness and learning strategies. Moreover, age does not change the route of acquisition: children and adults pass through broadly similar developmental stages, differing mainly in rate and ultimate attainment.

Comment. In its strong form ("children are better at everything") the hypothesis is untenable for L2 learning; a weak interpretation is defensible - there may be sensitive periods for particular aspects of language, notably phonology, and each age has its own advantages. For teaching, this means age alone does not decide success: instruction should exploit adults' cognitive strengths while providing rich early exposure to pronunciation, and motivation, aptitude and learning strategies remain decisive at any age.
——
📌 解析：考Chapter 11关键期假说（笔记Chapter11 pp.27-28）。essay 需定义+证据+局限+评论：两假设中"儿童神经基础不同"真值仍有争议，"儿童全面优于成人"已被后续研究挑战；支持性结论是儿童发音占优、成人认知占优，且年龄不改变习得路线。失分点：只背定义不作评价；断言儿童在各方面都优于成人；不提教学法启示。

front: 〔真题·2015年 简答〕Describe the non-standard English constructions in “We can't got none” and “He just lazy.”
back:
In "We can't got none" two non-standard features appear. First, multiple negation: negation is marked both by "can't" and by "none" ("We can't get any"), where Standard English allows only one negative marker in the clause. Second, non-standard verb morphology: "got" is used after the modal instead of the bare form "get". The whole sentence corresponds to Standard English "We can't get any". In "He just lazy" the copula is deleted: Standard English requires "He is just lazy". This zero copula is a systematic feature of several non-standard varieties, especially where the missing form would be a contracted 's. Both sentences show that non-standard varieties are rule-governed rather than merely "wrong": their grammar differs from the standard variety in regular, describable ways.
——
📌 解析：考Chapter 9语言变体（笔记Chapter9 pp.11-12：非标准变体有自己的系统规则）并可与Ch11错误分析衔接。要点：多重否定（can't...none）、动词形态误用（can't got）、系词省略/零系词（He just lazy，缩略 's 位置最易脱落），对应标准英语 We can't get any / He is just lazy。失分点：只笼统说"不合语法"而不指出具体机制与标准形式。

front: 〔真题·2015年 名词解释〕Explain the Beat Generation, Jazz Age, interior monologue, confessional poetry and international theme.
back:
(1) Beat Generation: a group of post-WWII American writers (Jack Kerouac, Allen Ginsberg) who rejected mainstream middle-class conformity and materialism, celebrating road travel, jazz, drifters and spiritual quest; Ginsberg's Howl is widely regarded as the central poem of the Beat movement and Kerouac's On the Road its classic novel, in which 'the road itself is the goal' (高分笔记6, p1, p3-5). (2) Jazz Age: the name for the America of the 1920s, an era of jazz music, post-war prosperity, consumerism and loosened morals; Fitzgerald was famous for his depiction of the Jazz Age, and The Great Gatsby is its classic text (高分笔记5, p13). (3) Interior monologue: a stream-of-consciousness narrative technique that presents the flow of a character's inner thoughts, impressions, feelings and free associations directly, without conventional dialogue or authorial intervention; practiced by Joyce, Woolf and Faulkner (高分笔记3, p15; 高分笔记5, p25). (4) Confessional poetry: a mid-20th-century American school of poetry (Robert Lowell, Sylvia Plath, Anne Sexton) that makes the poet's private life — guilt, mental illness, family trauma, marriage — the explicit subject of intense first-person verse. (5) International theme: the term for Henry James's characteristic subject: the encounter and contrast between American innocence, energy and idealism and European sophistication, tradition and corruption, dramatized through characters who cross national and cultural boundaries.
——
📌 解析：五个术语均为美国文学名词解释高频词：Beat 与 Jazz Age 是'时期/群体'概念，要分别绑定 Kerouac-Ginsberg 与 Fitzgerald；interior monologue 是小说叙事技巧。关键区分：interior monologue（内心独白，小说意识流手法）不同于 dramatic monologue（戏剧独白，勃朗宁、丁尼生的诗歌文体）——两者互串是本年度最常见的丢分点。international theme 须落到亨利·詹姆斯'欧美对比'这一核心，不能泛答'跨国题材'。
source: 东师学科英语专业课二历年真题.pdf · 2015年真题（名词解释）

front: 〔真题·2015年 简答〕Answer five literature prompts: summarize The Great Gatsby; describe Faulkner's characteristic techniques; analyze Willy Loman through the American Dream; explain Poe's unity of effect; discuss Transcendentalism's definition, features and writers.
back:
(1) The Great Gatsby: Narrator Nick Carraway tells of Jay Gatsby, a mysterious millionaire who reinvented himself from poor James Gatz to win back Daisy Buchanan, whom he loved five years earlier. Through lavish parties he reconnects with Daisy, but she cannot renounce the security of her class represented by Tom. Driving Gatsby's car, Daisy kills Tom's mistress Myrtle; Gatsby takes the blame and is shot by Myrtle's husband Wilson, while Tom and Daisy retreat into their money and almost no one attends Gatsby's funeral. The novel exposes the corruption and emptiness of the American Dream — 'So we beat on, boats against the current, borne back ceaselessly into the past' (高分笔记5, p10, p14). (2) Faulkner's characteristic techniques: stream of consciousness, which allows readers to enter the characters' minds and feel themselves participants rather than observers (Benjy's section of The Sound and the Fury); multiple point of view, letting different narrators react differently to the same events so that truth is difficult to reach; mythic construction of Yoknapatawpha County (Jefferson modeled on Oxford, Mississippi) as a microcosm of the South; themes of the decline of the Southern aristocracy after the Civil War (高分笔记5, p22-25). (3) Willy Loman: an aging traveling salesman who has built his life on the American Dream of easy success and of being 'well liked'; unable to accept his ordinary life and his failure, he commits suicide so that his family can collect the insurance money. Miller described the play as 'the tragedy of a man who gave his life, or sold it, in pursuit of the American Dream': the dream turns a human being into a product and destroys both Willy and his sons (高分笔记6, p25, p27). (4) Poe's unity of effect: Poe's theory (set out in 'The Philosophy of Composition') that a short tale or poem should be planned so that every element — plot, character, setting, tone, and a length readable at one sitting — converges on a single preconceived emotional effect, such as melancholy in 'The Raven' or escalating terror in 'The Fall of the House of Usher'; the ideal poem is short enough to preserve this total effect. (5) Transcendentalism: a New England philosophical and literary movement of the 1830s-50s within American Romanticism. Features: emphasis on spirit, or the Oversoul, as the most important thing in the universe, with nature as its symbol; belief in intuition over logic and the senses; self-reliance, the divinity of man and optimism about human perfectibility. Leading figures: Ralph Waldo Emerson (Nature, 'the Bible of New England Transcendentalism', and 'The American Scholar') and Henry David Thoreau (Walden) (高分笔记4, p14, p17).
——
📌 解析：一题五问必须逐问编号分别作答，不可合并成段。五问分别锁定菲茨杰拉德、福克纳、阿瑟·米勒、爱伦·坡和超验主义五个考点：Gatsby 概要以'美国梦的幻灭'收束；福克纳答意识流+多视角两大技法；Willy Loman 必须扣 American Dream 而非泛泛的人物性格分析。常见失分点：把 Poe 的 unity of effect 误写成'单一主题'——它是'一切手段服务于单一预想情感效果'的创作论；Transcendentalism 漏答 Oversoul 或代表作家。
source: 东师学科英语专业课二历年真题.pdf · 2015年真题（简答）

front: 〔真题·2016年 名词解释〕Explain Imagism, the American Dream, the Lost Generation, Black Humor and Theatre of the Absurd.
back:
(1) Imagism: an early-20th-century literary movement led by Ezra Pound, characterized by the use of precise imagery and clear, economical language, breaking with Victorian rhetoric; Pound, 'the father of modern American poetry', was its leading figure, and his two-line 'In a Station of the Metro' is the famous example (高分笔记5, p32-33). (2) The American Dream: the national creed that everyone, through hard work and initiative, can achieve material success and upward advancement regardless of origin. American literature both celebrates and indicts it: Gatsby's romantic pursuit and Willy Loman's destruction dramatize its betrayal, turning the dream into a critical mirror of American society. (3) The Lost Generation: the post-WWI generation of American writers (Hemingway, Fitzgerald, etc.) who were disillusioned by the war and became expatriates. Their writings center on the war and its aftermath, are often autobiographical, and treat decadence and the death of the American Dream; Hemingway's The Sun Also Rises (1926) is the emblematic work (高分笔记5, p12-13, p15). (4) Black Humor: a literary device and postwar school in novels and plays that discusses taboo, gruesome or painful subjects while adding an element of comedy — 'a humor out of despair and laughter out of tears' — satirizing hypocrisy, racial prejudice and the dehumanization of the individual; Joseph Heller's Catch-22 (1961) is the representative work (高分笔记6, p5, p8). (5) Theatre of the Absurd: a dramatic genre originating in the mid-20th century among European and American dramatists of the 1950s and early 1960s, resting on the existentialist sense that, with transcendental roots lost, man is abandoned and all his actions become senseless, absurd and useless; it expresses this through non-realistic forms — illogical plots, repetitive dialogue and meaningless waiting — as in Beckett's Waiting for Godot and Edward Albee's plays (高分笔记3, p2; 高分笔记6, p27-28).
——
📌 解析：五个术语均为美国文学高频名词解释（2016 年原题，笔记中 Realism、Modernism、Contemporary 各章均有对应真题记录）。答题模板：'时期+定义+手法特征+代表作家作品'。关键区分：Lost Generation 是'人'的群体概念，Black Humor 与 Theatre of the Absurd 是'手法/流派'概念且同属战后；Absurd 须点出非理性、无意义与'等待'母题并落到 Godot 与 Albee。常见失分点：Imagism 漏掉庞德；Black Humor 只答'黑色'不答'绝望中的幽默'这一定义核心。
source: 东师学科英语专业课二历年真题.pdf · 2016年真题（名词解释）

front: 〔真题·2018年 名词解释〕Define diphthong, minimal pair, code-switching and design features of human language.
back:
A diphthong glides between vowel qualities within a syllable. A minimal pair differs by one sound in the same environment and changes meaning. Code-switching alternates languages/varieties. Design features are properties such as duality, displacement and productivity.
——

front: 〔真题·2018年 简答〕Explain conversational implicature with an example; compare traditional grammar and modern linguistics.
back:
Conversational implicature is contextual meaning inferred beyond literal content, often when a maxim is flouted. Traditional grammar is historically prescriptive and relies on parsing; modern linguistics is descriptive and empirical, treating language as a systematic object and including spoken data.
——
📌 解析：两问跨Ch7与Ch1/5：会话含义（笔记Chapter7 pp.24-25：假定遵守合作原则，说话人违反/漠视准则时听话人推出的隐含、非规约意义，宜配违反质量或数量准则的例句）；传统语法（Ch5 pp.11-12：源于拉丁希腊、规定式、重解析、缺理论框架）与现代语言学（Ch1 p.11：重口语、共时、描写解释、理论取向）之别。失分点：implicature 定义漏"依赖合作原则与语境推理"；传统语法只答"规定式"一点。

front: 〔真题·2018年 名词解释〕Define dramatic monologue and describe the Metaphysical Poets.
back:
(1) Dramatic monologue: a lyric poem in which a single fictional speaker addresses a silent audience at a dramatic moment or crisis. In listening to this one-sided talk — in which the speaker argues his case and unconsciously reveals his own character, motives and state of mind — the reader forms his or her own opinions and judgments about the speaker. It was the dominant poetic medium of Robert Browning ('My Last Duchess', in which the Duke's polished speech exposes his arrogance, possessiveness and cruelty) and was also mastered by Tennyson ('Ulysses') (高分笔记2, p67, p87-88). (2) The Metaphysical Poets: a loose group of 17th-century British lyric poets writing under the influence of John Donne, including George Herbert and Andrew Marvell. Samuel Johnson described them as a school of highly intellectual poetry marked by bold and ingenious conceits, incongruous imagery, complexity of thought, frequent paradox and deliberate harshness of expression. Their works tend to psychological analysis of the emotions of love and religion, draw images from actual life, and are characterized by simple diction, mysticism in content and fantasticality in form; the extended metaphor known as the 'metaphysical conceit' (e.g. Donne's comparison of parted lovers to a drawing compass) is their signature device (高分笔记1, p55-56).
——
📌 解析：两个术语分属维多利亚诗歌与 17 世纪玄学派，均为历年原题（2018 年名词解释 Dramatic Monologue 见笔记3 p2）。dramatic monologue 的三个要件——单一声部、沉默的听众、说话者无意识的自我暴露——必须写全，并与 soliloquy（舞台上人物独处自语）区分。玄学派的关键词是 conceit（奇喻）、paradox、wit，最好举多恩'圆规'喻为证，并引约翰逊的经典描述。常见失分点：把 dramatic monologue 等同于戏剧台词，或只列玄学派诗人名单而漏掉诗学特征。
source: 东师学科英语专业课二历年真题.pdf · 2018年真题（名词解释）

front: 〔真题·2019年 名词解释〕Define inflectional morphemes, gradable antonyms and negative transfer.
back:
Inflectional morphemes mark grammatical categories without creating a new lexeme. Gradable antonyms are scale endpoints with intermediate values. Negative transfer is L1 influence that causes difficulty/non-target forms in L2.
——

front: 〔真题·2019年 简答〕List the categories of deixis. Explain Sapir–Whorf, distinguishing linguistic relativity and determinism; give your own examples.
back:
Deixis includes person, place, time, discourse and social deixis. Relativity says language categories influence habitual thought; determinism makes the stronger claim that language determines thought. Examples should illustrate influence without claiming other thoughts are impossible.
——
📌 解析：两问跨Ch7与Ch10：指示语五类（人称/地点/时间/篇章/社会，笔记Chapter7 pp.18-19，各配例）；Sapir-Whorf（Ch10 p.21）：相对论（弱式）指语言影响习惯性思维与范畴化，决定论（强式）指语言决定思维；举自拟例子须体现"影响但不决定"。失分点：强式弱式表述颠倒；例子只举"不可译词"而不说明概念化差异。

front: 〔真题·2019年 名词解释〕Explain chivalric romance and the Shakespearean sonnet.
back:
(1) Chivalric romance: the popular medieval literary form — a long composition, sometimes in verse, sometimes in prose — used to sing the adventures, quests and courtly love of knights and other heroic deeds. Drawing on the Matter of Britain (the Arthurian legend: Sir Gawain, Launcelot, Merlin, the Holy Grail), it typically combines French and Saxon elements and dramatizes tests of faith, courage, purity and moral weakness; Sir Gawain and the Green Knight is the culmination of the Arthurian romances (高分笔记1, p16-17). It flourished in the Medieval English period (1066-1485) alongside the ballad, its popular counterpart (2019 年名词解释原题, 高分笔记1, p10). (2) The Shakespearean sonnet: the sonnet form Shakespeare used — a 14-line poem, usually in iambic pentameter, consisting of three quatrains rhyming abab cdcd efef and ending with a rhyming couplet gg. The theme is put forward and developed in the three quatrains, and the couplet ends the poem with a surprise conclusion or a shift of ideas. Shakespeare's sequence of 154 sonnets — divided into groups addressed to a young man and to the 'dark lady' — treats love, the destructive power of time and the immortality of verse (Sonnet 18: 'So long as men can breathe or eyes can see, / So long lives this, and this gives life to thee') (高分笔记1, p32; 2019 年名词解释原题, 高分笔记1, p25).
——
📌 解析：两个术语同为 2019 年原题（笔记1 p10、p25 有真题记录）。chivalric romance 的要点是'骑士冒险+宫廷爱情+亚瑟王题材'，并与 ballad 形成对照（romance 写骑士贵族，ballad 叙平民故事，笔记1 p17 补充拓展）；Shakespearean sonnet 必须写准韵式 abab cdcd efef gg 及'三节推进+对句突转'的结构，并区别于彼特拉克体 abba abba。常见失分点：韵脚误写成 abba；romance 只答'传奇'而漏掉 knightly adventure 与 courtly ideal 两个核心词。

front: 〔真题·2020年 简答〕Describe the three steps of error analysis and explain why linguistics prioritizes spoken language.
back:
Error analysis identifies, classifies/describes, then explains learner errors (e.g. interlingual or intralingual causes). Speech is primary evidence for language use/acquisition; writing is a later conventional representation.
——

front: 〔真题·2020年 简答〕Discuss learner-related factors that influence second-language learning.
back:
Learner-related (internal) factors that influence second language learning include: (1) Motivation, the single most striking factor - instrumental vs integrative motivation, integratively motivated learners being more likely to succeed; later views add cognitive/resultative motivation, since achievement in turn sustains motivation. (2) Language aptitude, the special ability for learning a second language, a conglomerate of abilities: phonemic coding ability, grammatical sensitivity, inductive language-learning ability and rote-learning ability (Carroll and Sapon), with working memory central in newer models. (3) Age: children are better learners in pronunciation while adults are advantageous in cognitive capabilities; age does not change the route of acquisition. (4) Learning strategies: metacognitive strategies (e.g. selective attention), cognitive strategies (e.g. inferencing) and social/affective strategies (e.g. asking for clarification); successful learners use more and more varied strategies. Together with social factors such as language policy and social demand, these individual differences largely explain variation in L2 outcomes.
——
📌 解析：考Chapter 11学习者因素（笔记Chapter11 pp.26-28）：动机（工具型/融入型；认知/结果动机——是成就支撑动机）、语言学能（Carroll & Sapon 四能力；工作记忆）、年龄（儿童发音占优、成人认知占优）、学习策略（元认知/认知/社会情感，成功学习者策略更多更活）。失分点：只答 motivation 一点；把社会因素（政策、社会需求等外因）混入学习者因素。
source: 东师学科英语专业课二历年真题.pdf · 2020年真题（简答）

front: 〔真题·2020年 名词解释〕Define soliloquy and place Moll Flanders in English novel history.
back:
(1) Soliloquy: the act of talking to oneself, whether silently or aloud; in drama it denotes the convention by which a character, alone on the stage, utters his or her thoughts aloud. Playwrights use it as a convenient device to convey information about a character's motives and state of mind, for purposes of exposition, and to guide the judgments and responses of the audience. Marlowe's Dr. Faustus opens with a long expository soliloquy and concludes with another expressing Faustus' frantic attempts to escape damnation; the best-known of all dramatic soliloquies is Hamlet's 'To be, or not to be' (高分笔记1, p34; 2020 年名词解释原题, 高分笔记1, p25). (2) Moll Flanders in English novel history: Moll Flanders (1722) is Daniel Defoe's more mature piece after Robinson Crusoe, written in an autobiographical form called memoirs and narrated as the adventures of its female protagonist. Its historical significance is threefold: Defoe — the first writer to study lower-class people and regarded as the founder of the 18th-century English realistic novel — introduces for the first time a lowly woman as the subject of literature; the novel anticipates later works that take women as the center of attention in order to expose how the social system victimizes them; and it stands with Robinson Crusoe and Richardson's Pamela at the rise of the English novel in the 18th century, a fiction of ordinary life, morality and domestic manners (高分笔记2, p16, p27, p49; 2020 年名词解释原题, 高分笔记2, p3).
——
📌 解析：一个戏剧术语加一个小说史定位题（均为 2020 年原题，笔记1 p25、笔记2 p3 有记录）。soliloquy 三个要点：独处舞台、出声自语、揭示心理并引导观众判断——注意与 dramatic monologue（诗歌中向沉默听众讲话）区分。Moll Flanders 不必复述情节，重点在其小说史意义：自传体、第一个以底层女性为主人公、笛福作为 18 世纪英国现实主义小说奠基人的地位。常见失分点：把 Moll Flanders 误记为菲尔丁或理查逊的作品。
source: 东师学科英语专业课二历年真题.pdf · 2020年真题（名词解释）

front: 〔真题·2021年 名词解释〕Define sense, immediate constituent analysis, conversational implicature and deixis.
back:
Sense concerns meaning relations in the language system, distinct from external reference. Immediate constituent analysis recursively divides structures. Conversational implicature is inferred contextual meaning. Deixis uses context-dependent expressions for participant, place, time, discourse or social reference.
——
📌 解析：四个定义跨Ch6/5/7：sense 指语言系统内的意义关系、与指称（外部世界对应）相对（笔记Chapter6 pp.2-3：dragon 有 sense 无 referent）；直接成分分析（Ch5 p.12：自上而下逐层切分）；会话含义（Ch7 pp.24-25）；指示语（Ch7 pp.18-19：依赖语境的指点语，五类）。失分点：sense 答成"词典义"而不提与 reference 的对照；implicature 与 entailment/presupposition 混淆。
source: 东师学科英语专业课二历年真题.pdf · 2021年真题（名词解释）

front: 〔真题·2021年 简答〕Explain how hedges work and why sentence meaning is not simply the sum of isolated word meanings.
back:
Hedges soften force/commitment and manage uncertainty or politeness. Sentence interpretation combines lexical and compositional meaning with context, speaker intention and pragmatic inference.
——
📌 解析：两问跨Ch7/4：模糊语（笔记Chapter7 pp.27-28：approximators 含 adaptors/rounders，shields 含 plausibility/attribution；语用功能一是表明违反准则、二是礼貌缓和 like "I wonder if you could..."）；句子意义非词义简单相加（Ch4 p.8 词的符号功能：语言只提供概念构建的提示，理解需组合词义、语境、说话人意图与语用推理）。失分点：hedges 不分类；第二问只答"组合关系"而不提语境与推理。
source: 东师学科英语专业课二历年真题.pdf · 2021年真题（简答）

front: 〔真题·2021年 名词解释〕Define stream of consciousness and sentimentalism.
back:
(1) Stream of consciousness: a narrative mode that assumes a person's most significant existence lies in the mental and emotional world rather than the outside world; influenced by Freud's theory of the unconscious, it holds that mental life is not linear and logical but fragmentary and associative, and that the writer's task is to reveal this psychological reality in words. Woolf defines it as following the lines of a character's thoughts as they occur — describing unspoken thoughts without resorting to conventional dialogue. Masters: James Joyce (Ulysses), Virginia Woolf (Mrs Dalloway) and William Faulkner (The Sound and the Fury) (高分笔记3, p4, p13, p15; 高分笔记5, p25; 2021 年名词解释原题, 高分笔记3, p2). (2) Sentimentalism: an 18th-century English literary trend that arose as a reaction against neoclassical rationality and cold reason, indulging in emotion, sympathy and tears for the poor, the suffering and the wronged in order to awaken the reader's moral feeling; its reliance on subjective points of view made it a forerunner of the modern psychological novel. Representatives: Tobias Smollett, Laurence Sterne (Tristram Shandy; A Sentimental Journey — himself a forerunner of stream of consciousness) and Goldsmith (The Vicar of Wakefield) (高分笔记2, p9-10; 2021 年名词解释原题, 高分笔记2, p3).
——
📌 解析：一古一今两个术语（均为 2021 年原题，笔记2 p3、笔记3 p2 有记录）。意识流要答出三个'假设'：心理世界高于外部世界、思维非线性而具片段性与联想性、作家的任务是呈现心理现实，再落到 Joyce-Woolf-Faulkner 三位代表；感伤主义须放在 18 世纪对新古典主义'理性崇拜'的反拨语境中作答。常见失分点：把 sentimentalism 与 Romanticism 混为一谈——前者是 18 世纪中后期的过渡潮流、浪漫主义的前奏；意识流漏掉'非逻辑、片段联想'这一核心特征。
source: 东师学科英语专业课二历年真题.pdf · 2021年真题（名词解释）

front: 〔真题·2022年 名词解释〕Define bound morphemes and complementary antonyms.
back:
A bound morpheme cannot stand alone and attaches to another morpheme. Complementary antonyms are mutually exclusive opposites in the relevant sense (e.g. alive/dead).
——
📌 解析：考Chapter 4黏着词素（笔记Chapter4 p.4：不能独立使用、须附着于自由词素，如 de-、-ly 及屈折词缀；注意有的黏着词素与自由词素同形异义）与Chapter 6互补反义词（pp.5-6：肯定一方即蕴涵否定另一方，无比较级、不受程度副词修饰、不用于 how 问句，如 alive/dead）。失分点：与等级反义词（rich/poor）混淆；黏着词素只举例缀不给定义。
source: 东师学科英语专业课二历年真题.pdf · 2022年真题（名词解释）

front: 〔真题·2022年 名词解释〕Define ballad and critical realism.
back:
(1) Ballad: a narrative poem or song that tells a story in short stanzas. A ballad usually opens abruptly and gets to the point immediately, because its audience already knows the characters and plot; it concentrates on a single dramatic episode, narrates the story through dialogue and action, and is marked by theatricality; its theme is usually tragic. Subjects range from warfare, bloodshed and superstition to domesticity and exile; the 'border ballads' of the Anglo-Scottish frontier and the Robin Hood ballads celebrating the outlaw's fight against oppressors are the most famous (高分笔记1, p16-17). (2) Critical realism: the dominant mode of the Victorian novel (and of 19th-century European fiction generally), which gives a truthful depiction of people's lives while launching bitter and strong criticism of capitalist society — its money-worship and Utilitarianism, hypocrisy, poverty and injustice — so as to awaken the public consciousness to social problems and to promote reform. Victorian critical realists set their plots against a broad social background with strong cause-effect sequences and a pronounced moral purpose; Charles Dickens is its greatest representative, exposing in novel after novel the poverty, hypocrisy and corruptness around him, and the tradition runs through Thackeray, the Brontës, George Eliot to Hardy's Tess of the d'Urbervilles (高分笔记2, p63-65, p68-69).
——
📌 解析：ballad 是中世纪通俗叙事文类（2019 年同卷曾考 chivalric romance，两者恰成'雅俗对照'），答'突变式开头+单一事件+对话与动作+悲剧性'即可；critical realism 是维多利亚文学的核心概念，必须扣住笔记关键词 'Critical realism, Expose and Attack'——真实描写与揭露批判缺一不可。常见失分点：只答'现实主义'而丢掉 critical（批判性、唤醒公众意识）这一层；ballad 漏掉与 romance 的对比。
source: 东师学科英语专业课二历年真题.pdf · 2022年真题（名词解释）

front: 〔真题·2023年 名词解释〕Define entailment and lingua franca.
back:
A entails B when truth of A necessarily guarantees B. A lingua franca is a shared language used among speakers with different native languages.
——
📌 解析：考Chapter 6蕴涵（笔记Chapter6 p.11：X 为真则 Y 必然为真，如 spinster entails woman）与Chapter 1通用语（p.7：不同母语者之间用来打破交际屏障的自然语言，如英语）。失分点：entailment 与 presupposition 混淆（预设是话语成立的背景条件）；lingua franca 误答成"人造语言"（那是 Esperanto 类 artificial language）。

front: 〔真题·2023年 简答〕Compare animal communication with human language using design features. Name corpus evidence useful to language teaching.
back:
Human language has properties such as productivity, displacement and duality; animal systems usually have more restricted signals. Corpus evidence can show frequency, collocation, grammar, register and authentic usage.
——
📌 解析：考Chapter 1设计特征用于人兽交际对比（笔记Chapter1 pp.3-6：创造力与双重分节为人类语言独有，其余特征动物系统至多低程度具备个别项，无一具备全部）；语料库对教学的证据可答频率信息、搭配、语法与语域分布、真实用法等。失分点：只罗列设计特征而不与动物系统逐项对比；语料库部分空泛不具体。
source: 东师学科英语专业课二历年真题.pdf · 2023年真题（简答）

front: 〔真题·2023年 简答〕Explain Halliday's ideational, interpersonal and textual metafunctions.
back:
Ideational function construes experience; interpersonal function enacts social relations/speaker roles; textual function organizes messages into coherent discourse.
——
📌 解析：考Halliday三大元功能（笔记Chapter1 pp.6-7、Chapter5 p.16）：概念功能以语言为符号密码表征经验世界（由及物性系统实现）；人际功能维系社区成员关系、表达致谢道歉等交际角色（由语气与情态实现）；语篇功能组织信息成连贯语篇、与上下文及语境衔接（由主位结构与衔接实现）。失分点：三个功能与各自体现方式（transitivity/mood & modality/theme & rheme）配对错误。

front: 〔真题·2024年 名词解释〕Define language acquisition, syntactic categories, referential meaning and conceptual metaphor theory.
back:
Language acquisition: the natural process of children's language development, i.e. picking up the mother tongue subconsciously in social communication; by extension, second language acquisition is the process by which a language other than the mother tongue is learnt in a natural setting or in a classroom.
Syntactic categories: a syntactic category is a class of words or phrases that can substitute for one another without loss of grammaticality, e.g. NP, VP, PP, Det, Adj, Aux; in "A naughty boy broke the window", "a naughty boy", "he", "John" all belong to the category NP.
Referential meaning: the central and most stable part of word meaning - the relation by which a word picks out or identifies an entity in the world (e.g. dog denotes a kind of domestic animal), as opposed to the less stable, more culture-specific associative meanings (connotative, social, affective, reflected, collocative).
Conceptual metaphor theory: the cognitive-semantic view that metaphor is not a rhetorical decoration but a cognitive device essential to thought. We understand an abstract, less-structured target domain in terms of a concrete, familiar source domain through systematic correspondences called mapping, e.g. LIFE IS A JOURNEY (birth = beginning of journey, death = reaching destination). Metaphors are systematic, create similarities between domains, and unite reasoning and imagination.
——
📌 解析：四个定义跨Ch11/5/6：语言习得（笔记Chapter11 pp.25-26：儿童在社交中自然习得母语的过程，SLA 则含课堂与自然环境）；句法范畴（Chapter5 p.11/p.13：可相互替换而不失语法性的表达类，如 NP/VP）；指称意义（Chapter6 p.3：词指称世界实体的中心稳定意义，区别于联想意义）；概念隐喻理论（Chapter6 pp.13-14：隐喻为认知装置，源域-目标域-映射三件套，如 LIFE IS A JOURNEY）。失分点：conceptual metaphor 只答修辞格不提认知机制与映射。
source: 东师学科英语专业课二历年真题.pdf · 2024年真题（名词解释）

front: 〔真题·2024年 简答〕Answer three prompts: how culture influences language; how communicative competence differs from linguistic competence; and how intake differs from input.
back:
(1) How culture influences language: language is influenced and even shaped by culture; it is culturally loaded and culturally dependent, and culture exerts a strong influence particularly on the semantic structure of language and on its actual use in social communication (connotations and associations of culturally loaded words vary across cultures). Language is not only a system of symbols but also a socio-cultural activity, which accounts for the design feature of cultural transmission; without a cultural environment, language acquisition would be out of the question.
(2) Communicative competence vs linguistic competence: linguistic competence, in Chomsky's sense, is the tacit knowledge of the language system itself (its grammar). Communicative competence, proposed by Hymes and others, covers both the tacit knowledge of language and the ability to use it appropriately: the speaker can judge whether something is formally possible, feasible, appropriate and actually done. It thus adds rules of use - when to speak, to whom, in what manner - and underlies communicative syllabuses, which develop grammatical, sociolinguistic, discourse and strategic competence.
(3) Intake vs input: input is the target-language data the learner is exposed to, while intake is what is actually assimilated. Gass distinguishes the two and treats intake as a process which mediates between target language input and the learner's internalized set of rules: not all input is noticed, not all noticed input is comprehended, and not all comprehended input becomes intake. Output can in turn become new input through interaction.
——
📌 解析：三问跨Ch10/9/11：文化对语言的影响（笔记Chapter10 pp.19-20：语言受文化塑造、负载文化，尤其影响语义结构与实际使用）；交际能力与语言能力（Ch9 p.15：Chomsky 的语言能力是语法默会知识，Hymes 增加使用得体性，四参数：形式可能、可行、得体、实际完成）；输入与吸入（Ch11 p.30 Gass：intake 是介于目的语输入与内化规则之间的中介过程，未被注意/未被理解的部分不成为 intake）。失分点：只背交际能力定义不提四参数；intake 只答"输入的一部分"。
source: 东师学科英语专业课二历年真题.pdf · 2024年真题（简答）

front: 〔真题·2024年 名词解释〕Define derivation, language and linguistics, semantics and pragmatics, compounding, minimal pair, phoneme, free variation and assimilation rule.
back:
Derivation: the word-formation process of adding a derivational affix to an existing base to construct a new word (happy -> unhappy, good -> goodness); it may change the grammatical category, the meaning, or both, and the words formed are called derivatives.
Language and linguistics: language is a system of arbitrary vocal symbols used for human communication; linguistics is the scientific study of language - linguistic phenomena are observed, hypotheses are formulated and tested, and linguistics studies language both as a system of sound, structure and meaning and in relation to society and mind.
Semantics and pragmatics: semantics is the study of meaning, the analysis of conventional meanings of words and sentences out of context ("what does X mean?"); pragmatics is the analysis of meaning in context, dealing with the relationships between linguistic forms and their users (speaker meaning, contextual meaning, inference of invisible meaning).
Compounding: the combination of two or more free morphemes into one word (bookshelf, greenhouse). The rightmost morpheme determines the word class, the leftmost takes primary stress, and the meaning is not always the sum of the components (a greenbottle is a kind of fly).
Minimal pair: two words that differ by only one sound in the same position and differ in meaning (zip/sip, pin/bin), showing that the two sounds are in contrastive distribution and are separate phonemes.
Phoneme: the smallest phonological unit in a language that can distinguish meaning; an abstract unit of the speaker's mental representation, written between slashes, and realized in context by allophones (/m/ and /b/ in mat/bat).
Free variation: sounds that appear in the same phonetic position and can substitute for each other without any change of meaning; they are often dialectal variants (e.g. economics with /i:/ or /e/).
Assimilation rule: a phonological rule by which a sound becomes more like a neighboring sound. Progressive assimilation: the preceding sound influences the following one (the devoicing rule, e.g. play, snow); regressive assimilation: the following sound affects the preceding one (the nasalization rule, e.g. bean, bomb).
——
📌 解析：八个定义的大集合，逐个"定义+要点/例子"：派生（笔记Chapter4 p.6）、复合（p.6：左重音右词性、词义非简单相加）、语言与语言学（Chapter1 pp.3、9：任意性声音符号系统；观察-假设-验证的科学）、语义学与语用学（Chapter6 p.2、Chapter7 p.18：脱离语境的规约义 vs 语境中的使用义）、最小对立体（Ch3 p.10）、音位（pp.9-10：能区别意义的最小音系单位、抽象心理表征）、自由变体（p.11：同位置可替换不改义）、同化规则（pp.11-12：顺同化/逆同化）。失分点：音位漏"抽象单位/由音位变体实现"；自由变体漏"替换不改变意义"。

front: 〔真题·2024年 简答〕Answer ten short questions: distinguish greenhouse/green house; explain creativity; define taboo/euphemism and their relation; name Halliday's language functions; name metaphor components; describe English stress/intonation functions; relate phonetics/phonology; contrast anaphoric/cataphoric reference with examples; assess componential analysis; distinguish homonyms/polysemes.
back:
(1) Greenhouse vs green house: "a greenhouse" = an indefinite article + a compound noun; primary stress falls on green, and it means a glass building used for growing plants. "A green house" = an indefinite article + a modifier + a noun; stress falls on house, and it means a house whose color is green. Stress distinguishes both the structure and the meaning.
(2) Creativity/productivity: a design feature of human language - language provides opportunities for sending messages that have never been sent before and for understanding novel messages. The grammatical rules and words of a language are finite, but the sentences are infinite; even a child can put sounds and words into novel combinations. This feature is not found in animal communication systems.
(3) Taboo and euphemism: taboo is a prohibition on the use of, mention of, or association with particular words, objects, actions or persons (in English mostly body parts, bodily functions, distressing things and death). Euphemism is the avoidance of words which may be offensive or disturbing, substituting milder expressions (pass away for die). Relationship: taboos and euphemisms are two sides of the same coin - taboos are usually expressed through euphemisms; both are dependent on context and culture-specific, and euphemisms are in flux (crisis - depression - recession).
(4) Halliday's language functions: the three metafunctions - the ideational function (language as a symbolic code representing the world and our experience), the interpersonal function (language as a medium to get along in a community, to thank, apologize, argue, comfort) and the textual function (organizing messages into coherent texts that fit their co-text and context).
(5) Components of metaphor: the source domain (concrete and familiar), the target domain (usually abstract or less well structured), and mapping - the transference of properties from the source domain to the target domain by virtue of correspondences between the two (LIFE IS A JOURNEY).
(6) Functions of English stress and intonation: first, to highlight the information focus (the nucleus is stressed, the vowel lengthened, followed by a slight pause); second, to eliminate ambiguity - stress distinguishes compound from phrase (greenhouse vs green house) and intonation distinguishes sentence meanings and attitudes (falling for assertion and wh-questions, rising for yes/no questions).
(7) Phonetics and phonology: both study speech sounds but from different perspectives. Phonetics studies how speech sounds are produced, what phonetic features they have and how to transcribe them; phonology studies sound systems and patterns - which sounds distinguish meaning, how sounds vary in context, and which sequences are possible. Phonetics assumes invariant segments; phonology studies variation.
(8) Anaphoric vs cataphoric reference: anaphoric reference points backward to a preceding antecedent - "A boy and a girl are planting a tree. She is holding it and he is shoveling earth around it." Cataphoric reference points forward to a following expression - "When I saw her, Mary looked ill."
(9) Componential analysis: analyzing word sense by decomposing it into atomic semantic features (man: +HUMAN +ADULT +MALE). Merits: it made a breakthrough in the formal representation of meaning, revealed imprecise terminology, and handles hyponymy (father contains all the features of man). Limitation: it cannot be applied to the whole lexicon, only to words within the same semantic field.
(10) Homonyms vs polysemes: homonyms have the same form but different, unrelated meanings (bank: financial institution / side of a river); a polyseme is one word with several related senses (drink). Criteria for telling them apart: native speakers' intuition; etymology (same origin - polysemy; different origins - homonymy); dictionary treatment (polysemous senses under one heading, homonyms under different headings).
——
📌 解析：回忆型十小问，须逐条对应作答，跨Ch1/3/4/5/6/7/8。高频要点：greenhouse 复合词左重音、玻璃暖房 vs 绿房子（笔记Chapter3 p.15）；创造性（Ch1 pp.3-4）；禁忌语与委婉语一体两面、依赖语境与文化（Ch9 pp.14-15）；Halliday 三元功能（Ch1 p.7）；隐喻成分 source/target/mapping（Ch6 p.13）；重音语调两功能：突出信息焦点+消歧（Ch3 pp.14-15）；语音学与音系学视角之别（Ch3 p.9）；前指/后指方向与例句（Ch7 p.20）；成分分析优点与局限（Ch6 pp.8-9）；同形同音词与多义词三分判据：直觉、词源、词典（Ch6 p.7）。

front: 〔真题·2024年 论述〕Discuss features of modern linguistics; Searle's intentionality in pragmatics with examples; and Grice's implicature theory compared with Austin's speech-act work.
back:
Modern linguistics has four features. First, priority is given to spoken language, because speech is historically prior to writing, serves a much wider range of communicative purposes, is structurally more complex, and is acquired earlier. Second, its focus is synchronic rather than diachronic: linguists are more interested in contemporary language than in the evolution of languages. Third, it is descriptive and explanatory rather than prescriptive: it states objectively how a language is spoken and explains why, instead of laying down rules. Fourth, it is theoretically rather than pedagogically oriented, striving to construct theories that account for language in general rather than reference books for teaching.

Searle develops Austin's speech act theory through the notion of intentionality. In pragmatics, meaning is intentional meaning: in uttering a sentence the speaker's mind is directed at the world through intentions, and what is communicated is the speaker's intended meaning or illocutionary force. The same sentence "It's cold in here" can be a statement, a request to close the window, or a complaint, depending on the speaker's intention and the context. Searle systematizes this insight: utterance acts succeed under felicity conditions, illocutionary acts fall into five classes (assertives, directives, commissives, expressives, declarations), and in indirect speech acts one illocutionary act (e.g. a request) is performed by way of another (e.g. a question, "Why don't you go with us?"), which the hearer recovers by inference.

Grice attacks meaning from the inferential side. His Cooperative Principle, with the maxims of quantity, quality, relevance and manner, assumes that conversational participants cooperate; when a speaker flouts a maxim, the hearer computes a conversational implicature - implicit meaning beyond what is said. Compared with Austin, Grice's theory is inferential rather than act-based: Austin asks what people DO in saying something (locutionary, illocutionary, perlocutionary acts), while Grice asks how MORE is communicated than is said. The two are complementary: speech act theory describes the acts performed by utterances, and implicature theory explains how their indirect force is worked out; together they show that meaning in use is intention-based, context-dependent and inferential.
——
📌 解析：essay 三段：现代语言学四特征（笔记Chapter1 p.11：重口语、共时、描写解释、理论取向）；Searle 的意向性（Chapter7 pp.18、21-23：语用学研究意向的说话人意义；适切条件、五分类、间接言语行为；宜配 It's cold in here 一句多义例）；Grice 与 Austin 比较（pp.21-25：Austin 行为论——言内/言外/言后；Grice 推理论——合作原则与含义；二者互补而非对立）。失分点：三部分只各自罗列不做比较；Searle 部分不举例、意向性空泛。

front: 〔真题·2024年 简答〕British literature: define allegory, Neoclassicism and Metaphysical Poets; comment on Shakespeare's contribution; describe the historical/cultural background of the English Renaissance; discuss the rise of the English novel and Dickens as a critical realist.
back:
(1) Allegory: a narrative in which characters, settings and events carry a second, systematic level of abstract — moral, religious or political — meaning. Spenser's The Faerie Queene is a long allegorical poem planned in 12 books (six finished): a complex moral, religious and political allegory exalting Queen Elizabeth I and the English nation, readable both as a romantic narrative of the Red Crosse Knight's chivalric adventures and as a spiritual allegory of the Christian's struggle for salvation (高分笔记1, p36; 2016 年名词解释原题, 高分笔记1, p25).
(2) Neoclassicism: the 18th-century English literary trend developed under the intellectual influence of the European Enlightenment. It modelled itself on Greek and Latin authors and tried to control literary creation by fixed laws and rules; reason was stressed, so writings were didactic and satirical, elegance, correctness, appropriateness and restraint were preferred, and the closed (heroic) couplet was regarded as the only possible verse form for serious work; its artistic ideals were order, logic and restrained emotions. Pope (An Essay on Criticism, its manifesto work) and Samuel Johnson are the leading representatives (高分笔记2, p8-9).
(3) Metaphysical Poets: a loose group of 17th-century British lyric poets under the influence of John Donne (Herbert, Marvell), described by Samuel Johnson as writing highly intellectual poetry marked by bold and ingenious conceits, incongruous imagery, complexity of thought, paradox and deliberate harshness of expression; their themes are love, death and religion, their diction simple, with mysticism in content and fantasticality in form (高分笔记1, p55-56).
(4) Shakespeare's contribution: he stands at the summit of the English Renaissance. His achievements: (a) one of the founders of realism in world literature — his histories register the decay of feudal nobility, his comedies paint life and love freed from feudal fetters, his great tragedies (Hamlet, Othello, King Lear, Macbeth) depict the life-and-death struggle of humanists against the dark forces; (b) he adapted plots freely from Greek legends, Roman history, Italian stories and English chronicles, fusing classical form with English content; (c) his plays voice the desires and aspirations of the English people, are permeated with patriotism, optimism and humanist praise of love, nature and human dignity, and expose social inequality and religious persecution; (d) he was skilled in every poetic form — song, sonnet, couplet and dramatic blank verse; (e) he was a great master of the English language, adding many words and phrases to everyday English (高分笔记1, p38-41).
(5) Historical/cultural background of the English Renaissance: economically, the Enclosure Movement and the flourishing clothing industry created the capitalist and laboring classes and stimulated commercial expansion abroad; politically, the war with Spain proclaimed the triumph of the rising bourgeoisie over declining feudalism, England established her first colonies, and the Elizabethan Age brought peace, prosperity and the Queen's own literary interest; culturally, the introduction of printing accelerated the spread of books and knowledge; intellectually, the society in transition from feudalism to capitalism produced the Renaissance and Humanism, which exalted human dignity, potential and present life rather than the afterlife (高分笔记1, p29-31).
(6) The rise of the English novel and Dickens as a critical realist: the 18th century saw the rise of the novel in Defoe (Robinson Crusoe, Moll Flanders — the founder of the English realistic novel and the first writer to study lower-class people) and Richardson (Pamela), with Fielding, 'the father of the English novel' (Tom Jones, Joseph Andrews), perfecting its comic-epic form; these fictions focused on morality and domestic manners, and Austen later brought the novel to maturity. In the Victorian age the novel flourished — thanks to a new reading public, dropping book prices, professional authorship and the need for entertainment and satire — and its dominant mode became critical realism: plots against a broad social background, strong cause-effect sequence, and a marked moral purpose exposing money-worship, poverty and injustice. Dickens is its supreme practitioner: he maps the whole 19th-century urban world (especially London), builds complicated constructions with minor or parallel plots, is a great humorist and satirist, and makes the novel 'the instrument of morality and justice', exposing all the poverty, hypocrisy and corruptness he saw around him (Oliver Twist, David Copperfield, A Tale of Two Cities) (高分笔记2, p16, p27, p49, p63-65, p68-69).
——
📌 解析：2024 年英方大题是组合题，须按六个小问逐条编号作答，不可合并。三个术语按'定义+特征+代表'模板；莎士比亚贡献按五点展开（现实主义奠基、题材改编、人文主义声音、诗艺与素体诗、语言大师）；文艺复兴背景按经济-政治-文化-思想四条线，圈地运动与人文主义不能漏；小说兴起→批判现实主义→狄更斯要一线贯通。常见失分点：只写术语定义而漏掉'评论莎士比亚贡献/背景/小说兴起'这三个论述小问；各小问之间不作区分、平均用力。
